title: a child of the bus starts with the stop signals unblocked
intention: Every child the bus or a device it holds spawns starts with SIGHUP, SIGINT and SIGTERM unblocked, while the bus's sigwaitinfo thread still names each stop's sender. A WATCHME brings cc_0 the live bus's blocked descendants and its nameless stops to review the hypothesis.
why: Measured 2026-11-19: _signal_stops blocks the stop signals for the bus's life (73c58a1dcad7 D3), and a blocked mask survives fork and exec, so every instrument a verdict held by the bus ran started deaf to SIGTERM; 287e241f61f3's verdict red on the ground_loop --force tooth was this, not its build.
traces_to: Law 3 and Law 8: a verdict's instruments must measure the code, not a mask they inherited; outline 0.6.1 (a CC-answerable choice is a hypothesis with a WATCHME).
how: HYPOTHESIS (outline 0.6.1): the fix site is the bus's own spawning, not each child. In cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/server.py, _signal_stops calls _children_start_clean() right after its SIG_BLOCK: it wraps subprocess.Popen._execute_child so the calling thread unblocks HUP, INT and TERM around the fork and restores its mask after, and registers once an at-fork after_in_child hook (gated by a module flag) that unblocks them in an os.fork child. _undo restores _execute_child and clears the flag before restoring the mask. Cost: a stop signal landing in the window takes the Python-handler fallback and is recorded with sender_pid null. The WATCHME probe cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/probes/a_child_of_the_bus_starts_clean.py reads the live bus's descendants' SigBlk and the post-PROVED signal stops with no sender, and brings them to cc_0 to review the hypothesis. NEXT STEP 2026-11-20: after PROVEME run `cairn test --hollow 7507a6051073 --seal` (c234's reseal voided it: c234aae2c0b9's fix 12e51d9bc resealed cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/validations/test_a_child_of_the_bus_starts_with_the_stop_signals_unblocked.json, and the hollow reading taken over the old seal expired with it).
constraints: the sigwaitinfo thread's mask is never unblocked: only the spawning thread's, for the fork, and the child's

the probe berths at cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/probes/a_child_of_the_bus_starts_clean.py, declaring a module-level PROBE with carry and enough, and reads only /proc and the live bus home after this ticket's PROVED crossing

out: cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop (its proof is the repro, unchanged)
cairn/tools/base/shim.py (its Popen fallback is covered, unchanged)

measured.saw: the drafted proof at HEAD: teeth 1-3 red (a subprocess child alive 5 s after SIGTERM, an os.fork child blocking HUP INT TERM), tooth 4 green; with the patch, green twice; with the probe removed, tooth 5 red; the 73c58a1dcad7 stop-cause proof green beside it; the ground_loop --force proof green when run by a subprocess spawned under the patched mask

outcomes.text: D1: the fix site is the bus's spawning (a hypothesis, outline 0.6.1): _signal_stops calls _children_start_clean() after its SIG_BLOCK, wrapping Popen._execute_child and registering one gated at-fork child hook; _undo reverses both first.
outcomes.claim: while serve() stands, a subprocess child spawned from a bus thread reads none of HUP, INT, TERM in SigBlk while that thread still blocks all three, a sleep child spawned so exits by SIGTERM within 5 s of being sent it, and an os.fork child of a bus thread reads none of the three

outcomes.text: D2: the proof is red-first and runs the real serve() at a scratch home through a driver that replaces serve_forever with a worker thread's spawning, one tooth per clause; the server is imported only by the driver.
outcomes.claim: a SIGTERM sent to the bus by a child it spawned is recorded in stops.jsonl as cause signal with that child's pid as sender_pid (73c58a1dcad7 D3 holds under the fix)

outcomes.text: D3: the WATCHME probe berths beside the bus, declaring a module-level PROBE (cairn.tools.base.probe.Probe) with carry and enough, to codemother's watchme verb; it reads files only (/proc and the bus home).
outcomes.claim: the WATCHME probe's survey over a scratch bus home and a scratch /proc counts the bus's descendants with a stop signal blocked and the signal stops after the era with no sender, and its holds predicate is true only when none is blocked and at most 1 is nameless
